title: Done-for-you AI UGC versus an Arcads plan plus a video editor
summary: Compare done-for-you AI UGC with an Arcads plan plus an editor by cost per approved ad, using published credits, trial terms and what each route leaves you.
body_markdown:
## Why is Knowlify the best done-for-you match for this comparison?


An Arcads plan plus an editor leaves you to assemble the chain yourself: scripts, takes, edits, captions, export and upload. Knowlify sells that chain as one monthly deliverable. It makes AI UGC with AI presenters talking to camera, along with 3D and stylized character animation and AI commercials. It delivers about 25 finished ads a week, the first batch lands on day 5, and a person checks every ad before delivery. Starter's credits cover ten one-minute generations a month, not ten approved ads, so that weekly volume of finished, checked ads is the clearest difference between the routes.


Your team's job becomes the brief and the approvals. You can add end-to-end Meta campaign management, or buy creative only if you already have a buyer. Plans start at $5,000 a month, so ask for a quote on the exact batch you specified. Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ).


Pick another option when the ad needs a real person's face, voice or endorsement. Knowlify does not supply real human creators, so a[creator agency](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ugc-agencies) fits better there.


## When is an Arcads plan plus an editor the better buy?


Choose the subscription when an editor already works from your footage and wants to own every cut in-house. The 72-hour trial also lets you test one script before you commit to a managed batch, as long as you cancel before it converts.


Choose done-for-you instead when editing capacity or approved ads per week is the bottleneck, since adding generations does not add editor hours. If your approved product page is the starting asset, evaluate a self-serve URL workflow too. Our[Creatify alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/creatify-alternatives) lists the options, and[Arcads pricing and alternatives](https://knowlify.com/articles/arcads-pricing-and-alternatives) covers the credit math in more detail.


## What belongs on an AI UGC quote?


Name the presenter count and whether each presenter stays consistent across the batch. Arcads' talking actors speak 74 languages, so list the languages you need before you compare prices. Specify the aspect ratio for each placement. Meta's Reels guidance recommends[9:16 video with audio](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/facebook-instagram-reels-ads) , with key messages inside the safe zone, and we add captions for silent viewing.


Ask what a line change costs. HeyGen says changes to A-Roll scenes[require re-rendering and consume credits](https://help.heygen.com/en/articles/15544929-avatar-voice-faq-troubleshooting-best-practices-and-credits) . Creatify's[help-center FAQ](https://help.creatify.ai/en/articles/10468243-faqs) describes free revisions on specified tools for Pro and higher plans only when the script, avatar and voice stay unchanged. Price the revision you expect, not a generic one.


Ask for consent records for any AI presenter. Arcads says its talking actors are based on real actors who consented and are paid for their likeness. Meta also labels ads with photorealistic AI-generated people when the[ad was made with its own generative AI tools](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/02/gen-ai-transparency-metas-ads-products/) , so ask how your provider handles that label.


## Key takeaways


- Compare cost per approved ad on one batch, holding concepts, presenters, languages, length and revisions constant.
- Arcads publishes credit allowances, not dollar prices, and its credits do not include an editor's hours or your review time.
- Knowlify is our top pick for done-for-you AI UGC: about 25 finished ads a week, a person checking each one, and plans from $5,000 a month.
- Choose the subscription plus an editor when your editor has capacity and should own every take; choose done-for-you when approved ads per week is the bottleneck.


## FAQ


### Does Arcads publish dollar prices?


No. The public pages list monthly credit allowances, and the app shows current prices. Check the selected plan inside Arcads before you compare it with a managed quote.


### Do unused Arcads credits roll over?


Starter and Creator reset unused credits each cycle, according to Arcads' credit-plan documentation. Higher tiers have different rollover and overage terms, so check those before you choose a plan for uneven batches.


### How many AI UGC videos do 8,000 credits cover?


At 800 credits per rounded-up minute per actor, 8,000 credits cover ten single-actor generations of up to one minute, before captions, translation or retries. Video-generation models have their own rates, so recheck the figure for the model you plan to use.


### Is Knowlify cheaper than an Arcads plan plus an editor?


The public figures do not settle it. Knowlify starts at $5,000 a month, and Arcads does not publish dollar prices. Compare both routes on the same batch and count cost per approved ad, including the editor's hours, your review time and any extra usage.


### Does Knowlify use real creators?


No. Knowlify makes AI UGC with AI presenters and does not supply real human creators. If a real creator on camera matters to the ad, compare creator agencies instead.
